gaps.sentence: Had I realized the danger, I ___ the trip.
gaps.explanation: 'Had I realized …' = 'If I had realized …' + would have cancelled.

gaps.sentence: If he ___ so stubborn, we would have reached an agreement by now.
gaps.hint: present cause with a result up to now
gaps.explanation: An unreal present cause can produce a result reaching into the past; formally 'were' is used: were not.

gaps.sentence: If people ___ less time on their phones, they would read more.
gaps.explanation: An unreal present habit takes the past simple in the if-clause: spent.

gaps.sentence: If the appeals court ___ the verdict, the case will be reheard in the autumn.
gaps.explanation: Present simple after 'if', will + infinitive in the main clause.

gaps.sentence: If I had known you were coming, I ___ a cake.
gaps.hint: unreal past result, would have participle
gaps.explanation: The result of an unreal past condition is 'would have' plus the past participle: would have baked.

gaps.sentence: If you ___ me tonight, I will send you the files first thing.
gaps.explanation: A realistic future condition uses the present simple after 'if': email.

gaps.sentence: If we had left earlier, we ___ the ferry.
gaps.hint: unreal past, would have plus participle
gaps.explanation: Third conditionals take 'would have' plus the past participle in the result clause: would have caught.

gaps.sentence: I'd have helped if I ___ about the problem.
gaps.explanation: Third conditional: if + past perfect, would have + participle.
